lines.en: label undeservedfuture2:
scene nevermeanttobe1
: I’m just going to say it. I don’t think you had to hit me.
lines.zh: : 我就直说了。我觉得你没必要打我。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe2
: You have turned our perfect home into an abusive household, Mom. I think I might really need to call CPS after all.
lines.zh: : 你把我们完美的家变成了家暴家庭，妈妈。我看我是真的得打电话给 CPS 了。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe3
: It’s kind of crazy, though. I always figured if anybody was going to hit {i}anybody{/i} in our house that Dad would be the culprit. But {i}you?{/i} I expect better from you.
lines.zh: : 不过也挺离谱的。我一直以为要是我们家{i}有人{/i}动手，那肯定是爸爸。可{i}你{/i}？我对你期望更高啊。

lines.en: I’m sorry for not thinking or speaking much until now. I imagine you’ve been lonely.
lines.zh: 抱歉到现在为止我都没怎么思考也没怎么说话。我想你一定很孤单。

lines.en: I’ve been too busy trying to wrap my head around all of this, though.
lines.zh: 不过我一直忙着理清这一切。

lines.en: {size=-1}About how, one minute, this girl is ushering me through an interdimensional door on top of a roof and, the next, she’s calling me her father and perfectly assimilating to life under what’s left of my wings.{/size}
lines.zh: {size=-1}关于就在前一分钟，这个女孩还在天台上引我穿过一扇跨次元的门；下一分钟，她就叫我爸爸，还完美地融入了我那对残翼之下的生活。{/size}

lines.en: Ayane’s taking it a little better than I am, I think. Which isn’t to say this {i}hurts{/i} or anything, but-
lines.zh: Ayane 比我适应得好一点，我觉得。倒不是说这有多{i}伤人{/i}什么的，不过——

lines.en: Well, it does.
lines.zh: 好吧，确实伤人。

lines.en: It {i}does{/i} hurt. But it hurts for reasons I can’t quite figure out how to articulate and that winds up just making me feel more confused and speechless than anything.
lines.zh: {i}确实{/i}很痛。但它痛的原因我怎么说都说不清，结果只让我更加茫然、更加说不出话来。

lines.en: : I already said I’m sorry! It’s been a very emotionally taxing day, okay? And stop holding your chopsticks like that. Put them down if you’re not going to use them.
lines.zh: : 我都说过对不起了！今天情绪消耗特别大，好吗？还有别那样拿筷子。不用就放下。

lines.en: : If I refuse, are you going to hit {i}me{/i} next?
lines.zh: : 我要是拒绝，你接下来是不是要打{i}我{/i}？

lines.en: It all feels so normal.
lines.zh: 一切都感觉那么正常。

lines.en: Even {i}coming{/i} here felt like it was part of some routine.
lines.zh: 就连{i}来{/i}这儿都像是某种日常流程的一部分。

lines.en: We hopped on a train and rode it for three stops. I knew when to get off. I knew where to go next. And I sat right down at this table like I’d done it a thousand times before.
lines.zh: 我们跳上电车坐了三站。我知道什么时候下车。我知道接下来往哪儿走。然后我一屁股坐在这张桌子前，就像之前坐过一千次一样。

lines.en: I somehow even recalled the order in which the sushi would come out on the conveyor belt — salmon, then tuna, then squid.
lines.zh: 我甚至不知怎么就记得回转寿司送出来的顺序——三文鱼，然后金枪鱼，然后鱿鱼。

lines.en: The randomness of the subsequent plates didn’t perturb me either as I seemed to expect that as well.
lines.zh: 之后那些盘子随机出现也没让我不安，因为我好像连这个都预料到了。

lines.en: Even Himawari, who I distinctly remember confusing the ever living fuck out of me just a few hours ago, seems...familiar now.
lines.zh: 就连 Himawari——我明明清楚地记得几个小时前她把我搞得一头雾水——现在也显得……很熟悉。

lines.en: But I also feel like “familiar” is the wrong word to use because whatever I’m {i}really{/i} feeling is so much more powerful than that. Terrifyingly so.
lines.zh: 但我也觉得「熟悉」这个词不对，因为我{i}真正{/i}的感受比那强烈得多。强烈到可怕。

lines.en: It’s like I want to build a wall around us to prevent her from ever escaping. And the thought of her exceeding my expectations makes me both nauseous and proud at once.
lines.zh: 就好像我想在我们周围筑起一道墙，让她永远逃不掉。而一想到她会超越我的期待，我就同时感到恶心和骄傲。

lines.en: Those sharply pointed mannerisms...the way her ribbon matches her eyes...how she’s gorged herself on nothing but ikura since the moment we got here...
lines.zh: 那些棱角分明的举止……她发带跟眼睛的颜色那么配……从我们到这儿开始她就只顾着狂吃鲑鱼籽……

lines.en: Every last bit of it sets my mind ablaze and makes me want to consume her — just not in a way I’ve ever felt about anyone else before.
lines.zh: 这一切的每一分每一毫都让我的脑子烧起来，让我想把她吞下去——只是那种「吞」，跟我以前对任何人的感觉都不一样。

lines.en: It’s like a disgusting mix of warmth and fear and the creeping dread of abandonment sinking in every time her eyes wander in any direction apart from mine.
lines.zh: 就像是温暖、恐惧，还有那种被抛弃的隐隐恐惧混合成的恶心的东西，每当她的视线从我身上移开一点，它就沉下去一分。

lines.en: I hate it.
lines.zh: 我讨厌这种感觉。

lines.en: I {i}hate{/i} this sudden weakness.
lines.zh: 我{i}讨厌{/i}这突如其来的软弱。

lines.en: I’d take on a thousand gods if it meant I didn’t have to feel it anymore.
lines.zh: 如果能不再有这种感觉，我愿意迎战一千个神。

lines.en: Yet, I wouldn’t trade it for the world.
lines.zh: 可即便如此，给我全世界我也不换。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe4
: Of course I’m not going to {i}hit{/i} you. I’m just trying to instill good behavior in you while you’re young so you don’t grow up to be an abusive woman like me.
lines.zh: : 我当然不会{i}打{/i}你。我只是趁你小给你立点规矩，免得你长大变成我这样的暴力女人。

lines.en: Ayane feels the same way.
lines.zh: Ayane 也是同样的感受。

lines.en: We haven’t talked about it yet, but I can tell.
lines.zh: 我们还没谈过这件事，但我看得出来。

lines.en: Even with how experienced she’s become in hiding her emotions, these ones swarm her like locusts as she gracefully dances around them in a way that feels far more natural than performative.
lines.zh: 尽管她已经很擅长掩饰情绪，这些情绪还是像蝗虫一样把她团团围住，而她优雅地在其中周旋，那种姿态自然得不像是在演。

lines.en: And while she puts on a brave face and stays composed in Himawari’s presence, I know she’s screaming on the inside about the same things I am. So we’re in this together.
lines.zh: 虽然在 Himawari 面前她装得若无其事、保持镇定，但我知道她心里也在为我所想的那些事尖叫。所以我们是同舟共济的。

lines.en: : Well, it’s either you or Dad and we both know you’re the better one to take after, so...
lines.zh: : 嗯，要么学你要么学爸爸，我们都知道学你比较好，所以……

lines.en: All {i}three{/i} of us are in this together.
lines.zh: 我们{i}三个{/i}是同舟共济的。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe5
Which is why I’m not even offended by the jabs this girl has been taking at me since I regained consciousness on the floor of an unfamiliarly familiar living room.
lines.zh: 所以我甚至不介意这丫头自从我在那个既陌生又熟悉的客厅地板上醒过来之后，一直在对我冷嘲热讽。

lines.en: : You should really eat something else. There’s no way all that ikura can be good for you.
lines.zh: : 你真该吃点别的东西。光吃那么多鲑鱼籽，怎么可能对身体好。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe6

: {size=-2}Ahh, and {i}that’s{/i} where you’re wrong, Father. For ikura is packed with essential nutrients like protein, vitamin D, selenium, and omega-3 fatty acids that combine to promote good heart health and lower one’s cholesterol.{/size}
lines.zh: : {size=-2}啊，这你就不对了，父亲。因为鲑鱼籽富含蛋白质、维生素 D、硒和 omega-3 脂肪酸等必需营养素，它们共同促进心脏健康、降低胆固醇。{/size}

lines.en: : Which isn’t even touching upon how astaxanthin has been found to protect you from cell damage and prevent certain chronic diseases.
lines.zh: : 这还没算上虾青素被发现能保护细胞免受损伤、预防某些慢性病呢。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe7
: But also, it just tastes really good. And I have rightfully earned this reward after bearing witness to the traumatic event of watching my father nearly die before my eyes.
lines.zh: : 而且，它就是很好吃。再说了，在亲眼目睹我爸差点死在我面前这种创伤性事件之后，我理应得到这份奖励。

lines.en: : Where did you even learn so many facts about ikura?...
lines.zh: : 你到底是从哪儿知道这么多关于鲑鱼籽的知识的？……

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe8
: From Mom, obviously. You think {i}you’d{/i} have learned something by now too, being married to a nutritionist and all.
lines.zh: : 当然是从妈妈那儿。娶了个营养师，{i}你{/i}到现在也该学到点什么了吧。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe9
: You’re a nutritionist?...
lines.zh: : 你是营养师？……

lines.en: : How did you not know this clearly obvious and important detail about my life, husband? You, too, have brought shame upon this household.
lines.zh: : 这么明显又重要的生活细节你居然不知道，丈夫？你也给这个家丢脸了。

lines.en: : Our family is falling apart at the seams and putting my desired lifestyle as a stay at home daughter in jeopardy! Please get it together, beloved parents!
lines.zh: : 我们家正在分崩离析，我梦想中的「居家女儿」生活危在旦夕！请振作一点，我亲爱的父母！

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe10
: Is that really what you want to do with your life, Hima-chan? You don’t have any...you know, {i}bigger{/i} dreams?
lines.zh: : 你真的想这样过一辈子吗，Hima 酱？你就没有……比如说……{i}更大{/i}的梦想？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe11
: Bigger how? What can possibly be bigger than looking after one’s parents? You should be glad you have a daughter as loving and attentive and family-oriented as me.
lines.zh: : 更大是怎么个更大？有什么能比照顾自己的父母更大？你应该庆幸有我这么贴心、这么顾家、这么爱你们的女儿。

lines.en: : If anything, I’m offended that you think I’ll need to have a full-time caregiver by the time I’m 35.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我反而被你气到了——你觉得我到 35 岁就需要全职看护了？

lines.en: : {i}You’re{/i} fine, Mom. I have the youngest mother out of anybody I know.
lines.zh: : {i}你{/i}没事的，妈妈。我认识的人里，我的妈妈是最年轻的。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe12
: It’s {i}this{/i} guy I’m worried about. Especially if he’s going to be fainting from now on. You know what you need, Pops? More ikura. It’s got B12. And you know what that’s good for, Dad?
lines.zh: : 我担心的是{i}这{/i}家伙。尤其是如果他以后还要晕倒的话。老爸，你知道你需要什么吗？多吃点鲑鱼籽。它含有 B12。爸爸，你知道那对什么好吗？

lines.en: : {i}Hah...{/i}No, Himawari. What is it good for?
lines.zh: : {i}哈……{/i}不知道，Himawari。对什么好？

lines.en: : Brain health. Want to know who I learned that from?
lines.zh: : 大脑健康。想知道我是从谁那儿学来的吗？

lines.en: : Your mother, I’m guessing.
lines.zh: : 我猜是你妈。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe13
: Oh, thank god. Dementia hasn’t fully kicked in yet. We still have time.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。老年痴呆还没完全发作。我们还有时间。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe14
: H...Here’s an idea! Why don’t you tell us how your day at school went, Himawari?
lines.zh: : 我……我有个主意！Himawari，要不要跟我们讲讲你今天在学校过得怎么样？

lines.en: : You know...so we {i}don’t{/i} have to talk about your father aging anymore. Which is definitely not a brand new and unexpected fear of mine now. Not at all.
lines.zh: : 你知道的……这样我们就{i}不用{/i}再聊你爸爸变老的事了。那绝对不是我刚冒出来的、全新的恐惧。绝对不是。

lines.en: : Pretty normal. Science fair is coming up soon, so I got started on my project with a couple girls from class. Do you think you could pick me up a poster board this week?
lines.zh: : 挺平常的。科学展快到了，我跟班上几个女生开始做我的项目了。这周你能帮我买张展板吗？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe15
: Of course. What’s the project on? How far along are you?
lines.zh: : 当然。项目是关于什么的？进展到哪一步了？

lines.en: : We just started, but I can’t imagine it’ll take very long. We’re trying to figure out how to bring the dead back to life.
lines.zh: : 我们才刚开始，不过我觉得用不了多久。我们在研究怎么让死人复活。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe16
: Ahh...how nostalgic.
lines.zh: : 啊……真让人怀念。

lines.en: : I’m doing this for you, Dad. That way, I can raise you as a zombie and make you do my bidding once you inevitably die before us.
lines.zh: : 我这是为了你啊，爸爸。这样等你不可避免地先我们一步走了，我就能把你养成僵尸，让你听我使唤。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe17
: Please don’t. This is the first time I’ve ever really had to imagine a life without you and I do not like it at all.
lines.zh: : 别这么说。这还是我第一次真的去想象没有你的生活，我一点都不喜欢。

lines.en: : Himawari, stop scaring your mother with reminders that mortality is a thing that actually exists.
lines.zh: : Himawari，别再拿「人真的会死」这种事来吓你妈了。

lines.en: : {i}For now.{/i} Once science fair is over, though? Who knows?
lines.zh: : {i}暂时{/i}吧。不过等科学展结束之后呢？谁知道呢？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe18
: Oh, and I forgot to mention it, but there’s a field trip to Tokyo coming up in a few months. I thought maybe you guys might want to come as, like...chaperones or something?
lines.zh: : 哦，还有件事我忘了说，几个月后有去东京的校外教学。我想你们也许愿意作为……呃……监护人什么的跟着去？

lines.en: : I...will need to check my schedule as a nutritionist. Which is the job that I have.
lines.zh: : 我……得看看我作为营养师的日程。营养师就是我的工作。

lines.en: : You actually want us to come, though? You wouldn’t be embarrassed?
lines.zh: : 不过你是真的想让我们去吗？你不会觉得丢脸？

lines.en: : Of what? I love you guys. And also, I...
lines.zh: : 丢什么脸？我爱你们。而且，我……

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe19
: I thought it might finally be a good chance for me to see the town you guys grew up in?...
lines.zh: : 我觉得这也许终于是个好机会，让我看看你们长大的那座小镇？……

lines.en: : Assuming that...there aren’t still a million other girls there who want to jump Dad’s bones fifteen years later.
lines.zh: : 前提是……那里别还有一百万个女孩在十五年后还想扑到爸爸身上。

lines.en: : I...don’t know about that, Himawari. I imagine we’d have taken you by now if there wasn’t a reason for us to-
lines.zh: : 我……可说不好，Himawari。我想如果不是有理由让我们不——我们早就带你去过了。

lines.en: : Just a day. A {i}night{/i} even. We could stay with Aunt Sana or something. I just...
lines.zh: : 就待一天。哪怕{i}一晚上{/i}也行。我们可以住在 Sana 阿姨家什么的。我只是……

lines.en: : I owe a lot to that town since it’s what brought the two of you together. And my whole life’s been in Aomori, so-
lines.zh: : 我欠那座小镇很多，因为是它让你们俩走到了一起。而我这辈子都待在 Aomori，所以——

lines.en: : No.
lines.zh: : 不行。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe20
: Wait...{i}you’re{/i} saying no? But you’re the “yes” parent. You never refuse me.
lines.zh: : 等等……{i}你{/i}说不行？可你一向是那个「好啊」的家长。你从来不拒绝我的。

lines.en: : Is it because I didn’t call you Daddy this time?
lines.zh: : 是不是因为我这次没叫你爸爸？

lines.en: : It’s because {i}I{/i} don’t want to go back. And the idea of you going there without me is somehow even worse than if I were to take a trip there myself.
lines.zh: : 因为我不想回去。而想到你要在没有我的情况下去那里，不知怎么比{i}我自己{/i}去一趟还要糟。

lines.en: : You always make Kumon-mi sound so terrible. Aunt Sana loves it there, doesn’t she?
lines.zh: : 你总把 Kumon-mi 说得那么可怕。Sana 阿姨不是很喜欢那里吗？

lines.en: : Sana loves a lot of things that she probably shouldn’t and you should never look to her for guidance regarding anything ever.
lines.zh: : Sana 喜欢的东西有很多是她不该喜欢的，你在任何事上永远都别拿她当榜样。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe21
: How about you skip the field trip and the three of {i}us{/i} could go on our own little vacation somewhere? That sounds like a good compromise, doesn’t it?
lines.zh: : 要不你别去校外教学了，{i}我们{/i}三个自己去哪儿度个假？听起来是个不错的折中方案，对吧？

lines.en: : Mother, are you suggesting that we put my education in jeopardy over leisurely familial bonding?
lines.zh: : 母亲，你是建议为了悠闲的家庭团聚而把我的学业置于危险之中吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...y...yes?
lines.zh: : 呃……是……是啊？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe22
: Then, heck yeah! I’m in!
lines.zh: : 那还用说，当然好啊！我去！

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe23
: I’m gonna go hit up the soft-serve machine! Do you guys want any- oh! {i}Hokkaido!{/i} Let’s go to Hokkaido! It’s close {i}and{/i} they have the best ice cream!
lines.zh: : 我要去挖冰淇淋机了！你们要不要——哦！{i}Hokkaido{/i}！我们去 Hokkaido 吧！{i}又{/i}近，冰淇淋还是最好吃的！

lines.en: : Okay, Himawari...We can go to Hokkaido. Just...come up with some excuse for why you can’t make it to the field trip. Don’t tell anyone it’s for vacation, please.
lines.zh: : 好吧，Himawari……我们可以去 Hokkaido。不过……你得编个理由说你为什么不能去校外教学。千万别跟别人说是去度假，拜托。

lines.en: : Deal! Oh, I want to see the Moai heads and the Hill of the Buddha! And Stonehenge! Anyway, be right back!
lines.zh: : 成交！哦，我想看 Moai 石像和佛头山！还有 Stonehenge！总之，我马上回来！

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe24
: Stonehenge? Isn’t that in England? Can we afford that on your nutritionist salary?
lines.zh: : Stonehenge？那不是在英国吗？就你那营养师的工资，我们付得起吗？

lines.en: : There’s a replica in Sapporo near those other places she was shouting about. And surely we can afford {i}that.{/i}
lines.zh: : 在 Sapporo 有个仿制品，就在她刚才嚷嚷的那几个地方附近。{i}那个{/i}我们肯定付得起。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe25
: All things considered, I imagine that vacation will actually be {i}cheaper{/i} than what this dinner is going to cost us.
lines.zh: : 综合来看，我猜那趟度假实际上比这顿饭还{i}便宜{/i}。

lines.en: : Yeah, that girl can {i}eat.{/i} If I didn’t know any better, I might even think she was Maya’s instead of {i}ours.{/i}
lines.zh: : 是啊，那丫头真{i}能吃{/i}。要不是我清楚，我还以为她是 Maya 的孩子呢。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe26
: Great...You’re attached already, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 好极了……你已经投入感情了，是吧？

lines.en: : What, and {i}you’re{/i} not? You’ve been emanating murderous intensity the moment any other male so much as {i}looks{/i} at her ever since we stepped outside of the house.
lines.zh: : 怎么，{i}你{/i}没有吗？从我们踏出家门开始，只要有别的雄性{i}多看{/i}了她一眼，你身上就散发着杀气。

lines.en: : Which, without beating around the bush, I think is extremely attractive. And I can not wait until she goes to sleep later so I can pounce on top of you and rock your world.
lines.zh: : 而且我直说了，我觉得那特别性感。我已经等不及她晚上睡着，好扑到你身上把你折腾得死去活来了。

lines.en: : It doesn’t make you sick to your stomach? Feeling so strongly about someone you’ve essentially just met?
lines.zh: : 你不会觉得反胃吗？对一个你基本上才刚认识的人有这么强烈的感情？

lines.en: : It {i}does.{/i} But that’s how you know it’s love. And, I’m sorry, but I’ve decided that it’s better to just {i}let{/i} myself get attached and then hurt later when this inevitably crashes and burns.
lines.zh: : {i}会{/i}啊。但这恰恰说明那是爱。而且，抱歉，我已经决定了——我宁愿先{i}投入感情{/i}，等这一切不可避免地崩塌时再受伤。

lines.en: : You might be jaded since you’ve been hurt so many times before, but I can’t look at her and just let this pass. Not knowing what {i}she{/i} must have gone through to make it to us in the first place.
lines.zh: : 你可能因为受过太多次伤而变得麻木，但我没办法看着她，然后就让这一切过去。尤其是在知道{i}她{/i}为了来到我们身边，一定经历了些什么之后。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe27
: It could just be an illusion, you know. This might not be the future at all. It could be some sort of fantasy world designed to fuck with us.
lines.zh: : 你知道的，这可能只是幻觉。这里可能根本不是未来。也许是某种专门用来玩我们的幻想世界。

lines.en: : It’s only been a few hours. There’s no way of knowing yet.
lines.zh: : 才过了几个小时。现在还没法确定。

lines.en: : I’ll tell you what, then. When she sits back down at this table, if you can look her in the eyes and repeat those same exact words, I’ll revoke my attachment entirely and admit I was just being stupid.
lines.zh: : 那我跟你说。等她回到这张桌子前，如果你能看着她的眼睛把同样的话再说一遍，我就彻底收回我的感情，承认是我犯傻。

lines.en: : Ayane-
lines.zh: : Ayane——

lines.en: : She is perfect, Akira. You’re just uncomfortable because you’ve never loved anything this much before. And that scares you.
lines.zh: : 她是完美的，Akira。你只是不自在，因为你从来没这样深爱过任何东西。这让你害怕。

lines.en: : It scares me too, though. My heart’s pounding just knowing she’s twenty feet away getting ice cream right now.
lines.zh: : 不过我也害怕。光是知道她这会儿就在二十英尺外买冰淇淋，我的心脏就砰砰跳。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe28
: So it’s not just me then. I was starting to worry I might actually be having a heart attack.
lines.zh: : 那看来不止我一个人了。我刚才都开始担心自己是不是真要心脏病发了。

lines.en: : Does it make you happy? The way she looks at you?
lines.zh: : 你开心吗？她看你的那种眼神？

lines.en: : Have you ever felt that way before? {i}Truly{/i} happy?
lines.zh: : 你以前有过那种感觉吗？{i}真正{/i}的幸福？

lines.en: : Sometimes, I think. With you.
lines.zh: : 有时候吧，我想。和你在一起的时候。

lines.en: : Then how about we steel ourselves and forget everything before this? And just focus, instead, on being the happy family you’ve never had.
lines.zh: : 那我们干脆咬紧牙关，把这一切之前的事都忘了怎么样？然后专心去当那个你从来没有过的幸福家庭。

lines.en: : We need to at least...{i}talk{/i} to her, don’t we?
lines.zh: : 我们至少得……跟她{i}谈{/i}谈，对吧？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe29
: About how we got here. About whether or not she {i}knows{/i} anything.
lines.zh: : 谈谈我们是怎么到这儿的。谈谈她到底知不{i}知道{/i}什么。

lines.en: : Because, disregarding whatever’s happening to our feelings, that’s the same girl who showed up out of nowhere in the middle of a reset and potentially saved us from being completely decimated.
lines.zh: : 因为抛开我们感情上发生的一切不谈，她就是那个在一次重置中凭空出现、可能救我们免于彻底毁灭的女孩。

lines.en: : So both versions we’ve seen of Himawari are the same to you but both versions of Maya {i}aren’t?{/i} How does that work, exactly?
lines.zh: : 所以我们见过的两个版本的 Himawari 在你眼里是同一个，但两个版本的 Maya {i}就不是{/i}？这到底怎么说得通？

lines.en: : I don’t know how {i}any{/i} of this works. But she {i}might.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我不知道这{i}一切{/i}是怎么回事。但她{i}也许{/i}知道。

lines.en: : And if this does crash and burn in the end, I’d like to bring something back apart from more pain and misery when we already have an abundance of both of those things.
lines.zh: : 而且如果这一切最后真的崩塌了，我希望除了更多的痛苦和不幸之外，还能带点别的东西回去——毕竟这两样我们已经多得是了。

lines.en: : And if it’s as I expect and she knows absolutely nothing, then what?
lines.zh: : 那如果真如我所料，她什么都不知道呢？

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe30
: Then...
lines.zh: : 那就……

lines.en: : Will you leave it at that and just focus on today? Or will your mind stay caught on yesterday or tomorrow instead?
lines.zh: : 你会就此打住，只专注于今天吗？还是你的心思会一直卡在昨天或者明天？

lines.en: : You’re awfully calm about this all of a sudden.
lines.zh: : 你突然冷静得有点过分了。

lines.en: : That’s because, for the first time in my life, there is nothing left to want.
lines.zh: : 因为这是我人生中第一次，再也没有什么可奢望的了。

lines.en: : This is it, Akira. This is everything.
lines.zh: : 就是这样，Akira。这就是一切。

lines.en: scene nevermeanttobe31
: You really {i}are{/i} a simple girl in the end, aren’t you?
lines.zh: : 说到底你还真{i}是{/i}个单纯的女孩，对吧？

lines.en: : {i}Woman.{/i}
lines.zh: : {i}是女人。{/i}

lines.en: : I’m not just a girl anymore.
lines.zh: : 我不再只是个女孩了。

lines.en: : Yeah, well...watching you grow up in the blink of an eye didn’t do much help for my psyche either.
lines.zh: : 是吗，好吧……眼睁睁看着你一眨眼就长大，对我的精神状态也没什么帮助。

lines.en: : That’s the thing, though...
lines.zh: : 不过问题就在这儿……

lines.en: scene black
: I’ve been growing up this whole time.
lines.zh: : 我一直在长大。

lines.en: : You just told yourself I wasn’t.
lines.zh: : 只是你一直告诉自己我没有。
